quality.note: A section type is this project’s opinion about a span of markup, not a value read off the page. `other` is what the classifier could not name, and it is counted rather than absorbed into a neighbouring type. There is no hand-labelled validation set yet, so this share is the only published measure of how well the classifier is doing.
